narrative.overview:
Oddly combines supplied script artwork, deep blue ink, orange emphasis and generous Manrope typography. Fine rules and flat tonal surfaces organize the content without competing with the brand. The perspective-projected orbital visual gives the system a recognizable language of evaluation and connection, with a matte orange core and depth-scaled satellites.

Light is the initial theme. An explicit dark choice persists in local storage and is applied before hydration. Scroll-driven rotation, perspective tilt, continuous background evolution and hover feedback make relationships visible while preserving readable content, the native cursor and user control.
keyCharacteristics: Supplied Oddly artwork with optimized derivatives.
One local font family, spacious headings and concise labels.
Flat surfaces, fine rules and orange emphasis in two themes.
Orbital 3D motion, growing curved trails and pointer tilt with a diagram pause control and reduced-motion support.

rules.name: The Theme Pair Rule
rules.body: Resolve each semantic color through the active theme; keep the supplied orange artwork distinct from the accessible interface accent.

rules.name: The Local Voice Rule
rules.body: Use the locally hosted Manrope family for both display and body; use the supplied artwork for the Oddly wordmark.

rules.name: The Flat Surface Rule
rules.body: Separate page regions with tonal surfaces and fine rules; reserve the existing soft shadow for the language popover.

dos: Do preserve the supplied Oddly artwork and its light/dark logo variants.
Do apply semantic theme colors to text, rules, controls and the canvas.
Do keep visible keyboard focus and native FAQ disclosure behavior.
Do stop the diagram when paused, offscreen, hidden or reduced motion is requested.
donts: Don't redraw the wordmark or replace it with typeset text.
Don't add fabricated client logos, testimonials, metrics or dashboard data.
Don't make readable content depend on entrance animation or JavaScript.
Don't replace the native cursor or remove the diagram pause control.
